title: Hypothesis
description: Structured hypothesis produced for an incident by the investigation agent (AI provider or rule-based fallback). Raw model output MUST satisfy this schema before it becomes an incident hypothesis (Phase 4 Unit 3).

affectedServiceId.description: Service believed to be at fault (the version it was running is attached when known).

affectedServiceVersion.description: Deployment version of the affected service (e.g. v1.4.2) when known.

source.description: Who produced the hypothesis: the AI provider or the rule-based fallback.

evidence.description: Observability evidence the hypothesis rests on; never empty.
